## Coordinating action
Request, propose and negotiate shared or individual action.
Boundary: Require a successful request, proposal, commitment or response about action. Merely describing a desire or future event is insufficient.

Assess requests, offers or invitations, suggestions, commitments, acceptance or refusal, and negotiation. Giúp tôi chuyển cái hộp này ra cửa nhé asks for assistance; Để tôi xách túi giúp bạn offers the speaker’s action. Chúng ta nghỉ một lát nhé proposes a shared break. Ngày mai tôi sẽ mang dụng cụ đến can undertake a task in planning, but a future statement is not automatically a commitment. Hôm nay tôi không đến được can decline an invitation; naming Saturday can negotiate an alternative. Được can accept a prior concrete proposal contextually. A copied nhé without a recoverable proposal is absent. Particles and address terms express relationships, so do not require one formula for every speaker or reduce politeness to adding ạ. Judge the action and participants being coordinated rather than merely spotting a modal or imperative-shaped clause.

## Feelings and viewpoints
Express internal states, evaluations and positions.
Boundary: Require a correctly expressed feeling, desire, preference or position. An ordinary factual assertion is not automatically an opinion.

Assess desire, preference, emotion, opinion and agreement. Muốn học may express wanting to learn; it does not promise an action. Thích trà hơn cà phê compares preferences. Vui khi nghe tin này expresses an emotional response, while Tôi nghĩ introduces a personal judgment. Không đồng ý rejects a proposition or proposal. Hiểu rồi acknowledges comprehension and does not necessarily indicate agreement. Trà can answer a preference question contextually; the same noun in a stock list is not liking. A copied muốn without a recoverable wanted action is absent. Do not treat every factual assertion as opinion or every future plan as desire. Vietnamese does not require adjectival gender agreement or là before ordinary emotional predicates. Judge the stance-bearing construction in context and preserve socially appropriate alternatives to tôi and bạn.

Seek, supply and verify information relevant to the exchange.
Boundary: Require successful information seeking or a relevant informative response. Question-shaped requests for action do not qualify just for their form.

Assess meaningful information questions, relevant answers, factual confirmation and useful detail. Cửa hàng đóng cửa lúc mấy giờ? asks a closing time without English-style inversion. Lúc năm giờ answers that question contextually. Cửa hàng đóng cửa lúc năm giờ, đúng không? checks a proposed fact. Bạn giúp tôi được không? normally requests help rather than merely asking about capability. Cửa vào ở phía sân supplies an entrance location when that is needed. Bạn nói vậy nghĩa là gì? asks for interpretation of a contribution rather than confirming an external schedule. Respect ordinary brief answers and relationship-sensitive address terms. Do not invent omitted referents or treat a socially different but intelligible pronoun choice as failure of every informational function.

## Managing conversation
Establish contact, coordinate turns and repair mutual understanding.
Boundary: Require a successful opening, response, turn/topic action or repair. Sending any message or quoting a greeting does not automatically qualify.

Recognize greetings or closings, acknowledgement, clarification, reformulation, correction of misunderstanding and turn or topic management. Hẹn gặp lại closes contact. Bây giờ tôi hiểu rồi acknowledges comprehension without necessarily agreeing. Bạn nói lại được không? asks for repetition; Nói cách khác signals a rephrasing. Ý tôi là thứ bảy, không phải thứ sáu repairs a mistaken interpretation. Chúng ta chuyển sang câu hỏi khác nhé proposes a topic transition. A greeting quoted in a vocabulary list is absent as actual interactional work. A short vâng or dạ can acknowledge a particular contribution contextually; its social meaning depends on the relationship. Do not treat every question as repair or demand a pronoun where the context permits omission. Preserve ordinary regional vocabulary and tone distinctions without pretending textual evidence establishes pronunciation.

## Possibilities and constraints
Express capability, permission, requirements and epistemic limits.
Boundary: Distinguish ability, permission, obligation and likelihood. Similar wording can serve a request instead; judge the actual function.

Recognize ability, permission, necessity, possibility and confidence. Biết sửa xe đạp can describe knowing how to repair bicycles; có thể and được have several context-dependent modal or resultative functions. Tôi để túi ở đây được không? asks permission in a suitable setting. Phải trả chìa khóa gives a requirement, while không cần removes need and không được may prohibit an action. Có thể trời sẽ mưa presents a possible outcome. Không chắc limits confidence. Được can grant an earlier permission request contextually. A copied modal with no recoverable action is absent. A polite được không request does not necessarily establish a factual ability assertion. If ability and practical opportunity are both plausible successful meanings, subtype ambiguity alone is not unclear group use. Do not infer certainty or obligation from the presence of a future marker alone.

## Reasons and connections
Relate propositions through explanation, consequence, condition, contrast and support.
Boundary: Require a correctly expressed relationship between ideas. Sequence alone is not causation, a condition or an argument.

Assess causes, consequences, conditions, contrast and support for claims. Vì introduces a reason and nên can connect it to a consequence. Nếu and thì can establish a condition and its outcome; neither an English tense pattern nor verb conjugation is required. Nhưng contrasts properties, while sau đó can merely order events. Để normally introduces a purpose in an appropriate construction, not an already realized cause. An illuminated window can be evidence for an occupancy claim without causing occupancy. Vì trời mưa can answer an identifiable why-question contextually. A copied connector with no recoverable related propositions is absent. Judge whether the stated evidence supports the actual inference. Do not count any pair of sentences as reasoning, and do not reject an ordinary combination such as vì with nên solely because its literal English translation sounds redundant.

## Time and events
Locate events in time and express their temporal structure.
Boundary: One correctly expressed temporal relationship is sufficient. Present properties alone do not establish temporal skill. Judge meaning in context, not a tense label.

Judge present, past and future reference, duration or recurrence, ordering and phases without demanding verb conjugation. Tôi đang sửa xe đạp presents an ongoing activity; hôm qua can anchor a repair in the past without mandatory đã. Sẽ can mark future reference, but a clear future time phrase may suffice. Đã and rồi have aspectual or discourse uses and are not mechanical replacements for English tense endings. Mỗi tuần hai lần gives frequency; hai giờ can measure duration. Trước tiên and sau đó order actions, while đọc xong marks finishing reading. Hôm qua can answer a recoverable when-question contextually. A copied particle without an identifiable event is absent. A timeless property assertion does not establish temporal organization. Judge the meaning created by particles, time phrases and context, preserving natural omission rather than requiring all available markers.
